fusions.name: Buckler Skim
fusions.desc: Skims a buckler that deals 13 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Rebound Stamp
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A kick that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Turn Aside
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 8%.

fusions.name: Thrown Wide
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you gain a ward that absorbs 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
